{{Quote|The Imperial Crematorium. Each transport carries twenty dead Imperials. In the time that we have been here, nearly one hundred officers and troopers have been reduced to ash.|Gentis|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 3">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 3|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 3]]</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Crematorium''' was a domed shaped facility located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was used to cremate the bodies of [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].

A few weeks after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] [[Gentis]] saw the Crematorium during a meeting of the military council at Imperial Center. During even the first weeks of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the volume of dead in the wars waged on the Rim to pacify the Empire was so great that when Gentis arrived, in the short moments after they reached the crematorium, almost one hundred military personnel had been cremated. This high volume of death and carnage caused Gentis to believe that [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] needed to be overthrown to reduce the loss of life in his endless war.

During the [[Ghost Prison incident|Ghost Prison]] crisis, Headmaster Gentis committed his coup and assassination attempt against the Emperor. In that time, he attempted to persuade an [[Unidentified Imperial General (Gentis coup)|Imperial General]] to join his cause and watched the Crematorium where he recounted the origin of his plan. The Headmaster commented that it would not be long before they themselves faced the incinerator of the Imperial Crematorium as a result of Palpatine's wars.
